Maya R.: FYI — noticed a 3x GPU spend spike 00:30–02:00 UTC. Billing report shows a bunch of untagged GPUs in project redwood-labs-prod.
Owen M.: link? can you paste the BigQuery query? I'll look for owners
Maya R.: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/...?alert
Maya R.: ```SELECT project_id, sku, SUM(cost) as spend FROM `billing.gcp_export_v1` WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP('2026-03-22') GROUP BY project_id, sku ORDER BY spend DESC``` 
finance-bot: Automated alert: cost anomaly detected for project redwood-labs-prod (+$12.8k) — threshold $5k
Raj P.: That window matches the nightly loadtest for feature/llm-bench — CI job might have been pointed at prod pool
Emily S.: Did the lab team forget to use the staging pool? we have a tag enforcement policy but it doesn't block AI clusters
Maya R.: I see VM name pattern labs-batch-*, tags empty. Owner metadata missing.
Owen M.: I'll run `gcloud compute instances list --filter="name~'labs-batch-'" --format="table(name, labels, zone)"` and open a ticket. Leaving a quick audit query here.
Maya R.: We should reassign the cost to Labs (chargeback) and apply a one-time credit from internal budget. Emily can you approve?
Emily S.: Approve reassign and internal credit up to $15k. Please submit cost allocation PR and tag enforcement change.
Raj P.: Also recommend setting a hard budget alert on redwood-labs-* projects at 60% of monthly commit and a suspend policy for runaway autoscaling.
Owen M.: Created ticket FIN-5123 with query output and proposed allocation. Assigning to @labs-eng and @cost-op. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5123
ops-alerts: Deploy bot: autoscaler triggered 2026-03-23T00:45Z — scaled redwood-labs-prod to +12 GPUs
Maya R.: Next steps: (1) labs-eng confirm whether loadtest should target prod (2) ops add tag enforcement to CI (3) finance backfill allocation + note to customer invoices if external. I'm booking a sync 10am PT.
Emily S.: I'll sign off on the allocation doc once FIN-5123 has the cost breakdown. tagging policy PR should include `--require-tags` in CI. :+1:
Owen M.: summary attached: CSV + cost-by-team snapshot. ping me if you want a quick runbook for setting budgets/alerts.
Maya R.: Thanks all — will update thread after lab response.
